scope.owned_layer: Hosted HTTPS Agora service proof, exact-pair identity checks, controlled dev BFF recreation, and redacted evidence production.
not_changing: Agora BFF product routers or persistence implementations

required_properties: successful GitHub Actions run at the same BFF SHA served by /bff/version
frontend deployment.json bound to that exact BFF SHA and expected frontend SHA
fourteen passed stages with a positive authenticated HTTPS request count
distinct strict operator and peer identity fingerprints
actual BFF container recreation with distinct redacted before/after instance fingerprints
PostgreSQL workshop, governance, and dataset resource readback after readiness returns
redacted JSON artifacts uploaded from the successful exact-head run
hosted_evidence_contract.failure_policy: Missing, simulated, in-process, stale, non-HTTPS, mismatched-head, same-instance, or unredacted evidence is unqualified and must not close this task.

commands.scope: HTTP-only probe, exact-pair guard, redaction, and recreated-instance failure controls

owner_validation.hosted_workflow_run: pending_after_reviewed_exact-head PR merges and the matching dev FE/BFF pair is deployed

reviewer_checklist: Confirm the probe imports no product application, TestClient, or in-process store.
Confirm every passing artifact is produced only by the named hosted workflow and is bound to its successful exact head.
Confirm the lease guard surrounds the remote state change and --force-recreate is used instead of docker compose restart.
Confirm the workflow never prints or uploads raw client secrets, user subjects, container IDs, request bodies, or response bodies.
Confirm an actual successful run is attached before final owner closeout; implementation review alone is not runtime acceptance.
